summary: Tool rows in fractal-web show a semantic kind and intent, quiet routine failures behind a small error mark, and recorded service readiness, task results, waits and message sends. Opening a row is the single route to exact input and output; the kit default detail drops its second raw disclosure. An optional host renderer (Transcript renderToolDetail) supplies semantic details, and Open inspector opens the read-only tool inspector. The header gains a Switch agent command palette (Ctrl/Cmd K). A failed diagnostics bar no longer blanks the workspace.

schema.detail: No persisted schema change. Palette recents persist only bounded agent refs under the existing UI persistence store.

compatibility.detail: Additive: the gateway advertises conversation-blocks.v1, and old daemons ignore it; pages without blocks stay readable. The kit adds WorkKind wait, message, schedule, terminal-input, skill and eval, new WorkLogCall fields and Transcript renderToolDetail; ToolDetailPreview and the default call detail no longer render a nested Show raw input/output disclosure.
